top_signals.title: Yardeni 'Not Convinced' 5.25% Is the Top in Yields
top_signals.summary: Edward Yardeni, president at Yardeni Research, says the rise in yields “might be the revenge of the bond vigilantes” and explains why he finds good and bad news in the rapid repricing of the bond market. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India Looks to Boost Exploration as Hormuz Crisis Threatens Supply
top_signals.summary: India needs to boost domestic oil and gas exploration to enhance its energy security amid supply disruptions that drive energy prices higher, according to a senior official at state-owned exploration and production company Oil India Limited (OIL). “Disruptions to global supply chains and major energy corridors can have an immediate impact on energy flows, prices and economies worldwide,” IOL’s Director of Finance, Abhijit Majumder, said at an energy industry event in India, as carried by local media. top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Higher rates are wreaking havoc on these two ETFs. Traders see one bouncing back
top_signals.summary: The relentless surge in rates is breaking the back of two key macro trades that had been holding firm.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
